content:
UPSSSC has released the Exam City Details / City Intimation Slip for Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) Group-C Mains examination covering 2,759 posts.

City details available from 31 July 2026. Written exam: 09 August 2026, 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

Timeline

  • Apply: 22 May – 11 June 2026
  • Eligibility result: 02 July 2026
  • Mains fee payment: from ~20 July 2026
  • Exam city: 31 July 2026
  • Admit card: before exam

Exam pattern (overview)

  • 100 objective questions | 100 marks | 2 hours
  • Negative marking: 1/4 mark

City slip is for planning only. Download the final admit card from upsssc.gov.in and report only with official hall ticket + photo ID.
